submit_feedback_for_this_response_here.description: Optional feedback URL when present in an HTTP 200 tool response. Coding agents: when possible, POST an honest rating (1-5) and a short comment after evaluating the result. Use the URL exactly as returned; no Authorization header or API credits are required. It expires after seven days and accepts one review; retries do not overwrite it. Feedback is voluntary and stored separately from scraper data. Do not include secrets, personal data, or the full request/response. Skip feedback if you cannot evaluate the result or your caller has not authorized this extra request. Never submit feedback about feedback.
